quote.text: You don't get paid for activity. You get paid for the close. Everything before the close is just cost.
quote.author: Alex Hormozi

schedule: No calls on the books — check GHL/Calendly for new bookings before noon.
focus: Capital One sent a fresh alert this morning: "Card declined: Not enough credit." Open Ads Manager now and confirm this isn't the card funding your $35/day FB Ads — a declined charge silently kills delivery on your only live lead channel, and you won't get a second warning. If it's the ad card, swap the payment method before today's spend tries to run.

Still 0 closed from 27+ leads at a $17 CPL — roughly $460 spent on people who never booked. The gap is follow-up, not traffic. Run a personal call-and-text blitz through every unbooked GHL lead today with a direct booking link instead of waiting on the A2P automation that's still stuck in carrier review.

FB outbound is your only motion while sales is cold. Confirm the 9 AM auto-post hit all 16 groups and that ads are still pacing at $35/day — if delivery stalled or the group post failed, no new leads enter the pipeline today. Refresh the Missed Call / Two Phones creative if spend keeps fading.
